description: This is a Java source file defining the class `GeneralLedgerServices` which contains service methods for handling general ledger operations such as creating/updating cost centers and calculating total percentages.

classes.name: GeneralLedgerServices
classes.description: A utility service class providing methods for managing general ledger cost centers and calculations.

methods.name: createUpdateCostCenter
methods.description: Creates or updates cost center entries by processing a map of amount percentages and invoking the appropriate service for each entry.

methods.name: calculateCostCenterTotal
methods.description: Calculates the total sum of amount percentages from a provided map.
